sources.title: catalog/override source
sources.excerpt:
- **Builder:** Commune/ECA (Empire Custom Amplification)
- **Catalog identity:** Screem
- **Catalog type:** Distortion
- **Identity:** Rare Japanese Commune/ECA distortion pedal from the 2000s.

A surviving Tokyo retailer record identifies the pedal as **COMMUNE (EMPIRE CUSTOM AMPLIFICATION) / SCREEM**, with a 2000s production date and serial C/E011. [1] Effects Database also catalogs Commune/ECA Screem as a distinct pedal. [2]

A complete verified control layout was not recovered from the checked sources.

The surviving retailer listing documents one specific cosmetic specimen. No reliable production colorway history was established.

No reliable numbered revision sequence was established.

No verified Screem hardware chronology was found.

The surviving listing confirms a Japanese-market Commune/ECA pedal from the 2000s, but does not provide enough internal construction evidence to generalize component details. [1]

- **Exact transistor/device:** Not publicly documented.

- **Exact clipping diode/device:** Not publicly documented.

The catalog classification is distortion. A more specific voicing is not asserted without stronger model-specific evidence.

TC Gakki's ended Reverb listing states that all photographs are of the actual item and identifies the exact COMMUNE (EMPIRE CUSTOM AMPLIFICATION) / SCREEM model. [1]

1. Reverb - Commune Empire Custom Amplification Screem: https://reverb.com/item/10534214-commune-empire-custom-amplification-screem
2. Effects Database - pedal catalog, Commune/ECA Screem entry: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/taxonomy/term/8/0?page=46
